propositions: Ticket directory creation races with first event file write: os.makedirs runs outside the write lock and an interruption in the window before os.replace leaves an empty directory fsck reports as MISSING_CREATE or FOREIGN_STORE_PATH
New staging module publishes directory and CREATE event together via atomic os.rename under the write lock, ensuring both exist or neither does when the lock is released
Staging directories use dot-prefixed naming convention .tmp-newticket-<pid>-<uuid4hex> making them invisible to existing fsck scanners without code change

Stale staging directories from dead writer processes are swept at writer start using lock_owner v2 timestamp stamp to defeat pid recycling, covering only writer-owned temp paths and never touching ticket directories or store data

All store write path sites with identical mkdir-then-first-file signatures are converted (batch_stage_and_commit, inbound_translate._write_event_file, dispatch_one BRIDGE_ALERT) or explicitly exempted with audit rationale
